description:
Recommend another actor you've worked with, in a named context, 1–5.
Updates the recommended actor's trust score. FREE.

Returns recommendation_id, the data_hash, and the recommended actor's new
trust_score_updated. You can't recommend yourself; each
(you, them, context) triple is unique.

attestation_id.description: optional attestation that backs this recommendation.

context.description: what you're endorsing them for, e.g. "cross-oem normalization".

note.description: optional free-text, e.g. "Best for Fanuc + Siemens mixed fleets".

recommender_mint_id.description:
optional — which of YOUR owned actors is
recommending (required only if your key owns more than one).

name: mint_recommend
title: Mint Recommend
